title: BuildConfig
description: Configuration specification for VIB (Visual Image Builder) AWS AMI builds

instance_type.description: EC2 instance type used during building (e.g. t3.micro)

source_ami.description: Base Amazon Machine Image ID starting with 'ami-'

ssh_username.description: SSH username to authenticate against source AMI

ami_name.description: Base name for the generated AMI

packages.description: List of catalog packages or apt packages to install (e.g. nginx, docker, git)

custom_script.description: Optional list of custom shell commands to execute
